query: What automatic accept/reject thresholds (e.g., P>0.95 accept, P<0.05 reject) and clerical-review rule sets minimize bias while keeping clerical workload feasible?

response.query: What automatic accept/reject thresholds (e.g., P>0.95 accept, P<0.05 reject) and clerical-review rule sets minimize bias while keeping clerical workload feasible?
response.answer: Automatic thresholds of P>0.95 for accept and P<0.01 for reject minimize bias, while clerical-review rules focusing on high-risk cases keep workload feasible.
